substantive_analysis.title: City planning policies to support health and sustainability: an international comparison of policy indicators for 25 cities
substantive_analysis.publication_identity: The Lancet Global Health 10(6), 2022, pp. e882–e894
substantive_analysis.edition_relation: Syllabus citation lists only part of the author group; the supplied first-page byline has the full group.
substantive_analysis.source_bound_claim: Lowe and colleagues assess the presence, specificity, measurability and evidence consistency of planning policies, while explicitly leaving implementation and government performance tracking unexamined.
substantive_analysis.source_locator: PDF pp. 2–3 and 9–10; printed pp. e883–e884 and e890–e891

argument_steps.label: Design
argument_steps.statement: Policy content analysis covers 25 cities in 19 countries using convenience recruitment and publicly available policy material collected in 2019.

argument_steps.label: Operational method
argument_steps.statement: Record presence and qualitative strengths and limitations, including specificity and measurability, rather than infer implementation from an aspirational policy.

argument_steps.label: Scope limit
argument_steps.statement: The authors did not examine implementation or how governments tracked performance against targets. This study adapts the content/implementation distinction; its legal-effect categories are new coding choices, not the original indicators.

substantive_analysis.permitted_use: Adapt descriptive fields for aspirations, specifications, measurable targets and source status; code legal effect separately.
substantive_analysis.prohibited_inference: Do not treat a policy-quality score as implementation, legal validity or causal environmental performance.
qualifications: Convenience sample: 25 cities, 19 countries; 19 high-income and six middle-income cities, no low-income cities.
Agreement coefficients concern the first three cities, not a full-sample validity certificate.
Full coding appendix is separate and uninspected.
substantive_analysis.missing_dependency: Human source-fidelity and assignment-fit review; original Cerrillos instruments for any case-specific claim
substantive_analysis.case_application_status: proposed analytical use; not a case finding
